tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// zhe sa dgu phrugs bzhugs// ༄༅// 'gro mgon mnyam med ji snyed kun gzigs shing*// ji bzhin don ni thugs su chud gyur pa// thugs rjes 'gro kun 'dren par mdzad pa po// rkang gnyis gtso bo de la phyag 'tshal lo// ya rabs cha rkyen phyag gis bstan bcos ni// bstan bshad yan lag don skor dbye bar bcas// 'gos kyi phyag yig la brten khu yis mdzad// de la ma tshang la sogs skyon spangs bri// ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba gsum// rgyu dang rkyen dang gnas dang gsum// yul dang gang zag rgyan dang gsum// 'khos dang dam tshig sa bcad gsum// 'gying dang bca' gzhi 'dzum dang gsum// 'dur dang bsnyun med babs dang gsum// skyon dang sgra yang 'bras bu gsum// don skor nyi shu rtsa gcig go /ngo bo phyag byed gang zag de yis ni// yid kyis bskul ba'i lus ngag rig byed do// phyag ces bya ba 'di yi nges tshig ni// gong ma 'khur byed sgo gsum 'dud phyir ro// dbye ba rnam gnyis 'gro ba gzhan dang mi// dang po lha klu gnod sbyin srin po sogs// rang rang sde dpon rnams la phyag byed de// de yi dbye ba brjod par ga la nus// rang rig bsod nams ldan pa'i mi la phyag /dbye ba rnam pa bdun du gnas pa yin// dkon mchog rten la dad pas gus phyag dang*// bla ma dge ba'i bshes la mos phyag dang*// bslab pa khrims kyis rgan la bcas pa'i phyag /sa bdag rgyal po rigs kyi bla sgo dang*// chab srid blon po'i rigs la bzhes phyag dang*// pha khu rgan la rang gi rigs kyis phyag /bud med khyo yi rjes su 'gro mod kyi// lha lcam khyo la song sogs cung zad brtag /dkon mchog lha phyag bya yi sug babs med// bla ma khrims kyis rgan la phyag byas te// lha phyag de yang lus bsrangs rkang gnyis gshibs// lag pa thal sbyar gus pas rkang rtse gnyis// pus gnyis lag gnyis dpral lam spyi bo rnams// sa la gtugs la 'og gi 'gying sogs bya// sa bdag rgyal po phyag gi dbye ba ni// lha btsun rje btsun dge ba'i bshes dang 'dra// 'og gi sug babs bsnur yang nyes pa med// 'di la dbye ba rnam pa bzhi yin te// nyi shu rtsa gcig dgu phrugs chung gsum dang*// sug babs bzhi pa zhes bya nar ma ste// nyi shu rtsa gcig sa la dbye ba med// 'og ma gsum la gsum gsum dag tu dbye// khug pa zangs ma mdung tshugs zhes bya'o// phyag gi rgyu ni skye rgyud rigs kyi gtso// pha ngan bu la phyag dang zhe sa med// phyag gi rkyen ni blo yi rtse yin te// blun po rnams la che chung khyad par med// phyag gi gnas ni dkon mchog gsum gyi rten// bla sgo rab 'bring tshogs pa'i spyan sngar ro// phyag yul bla ma dkon mchog rgan pa bzhi// shes pas rgan pa'i dge bshes rnam gnyis dang*// khrims kyis rgan pa'i rab byung dge 'dun no// rigs kyis rgan pa'i sa bdag rgyal po dang*// na sos rgan pa'i pha khu rgan rim mo// phyag byed gang zag bzhi yod gong las bzlog

/blo dman khrims ma rdzogs dang rigs dman gzhon// rgyan la gsum yod gos tshugs bzang la mdzes// lus yang yan lag mnyen zhing phu dung bzang*// 'khos la gsum yod lung pa'i 'dug phyogs dang*// dkon mchog rten dang gral mgo'i bkod pa ste// phyag bya'i yul de gang la ji ltar bzhugs// ma brtags bar la lus kyi phyag mi bya// dam tshig bdag rang mkhas pa'i nga rgyal dang*// sems brtan shab shib mi bya snga phyi sgrig /sa bcad dang po phyag gi byed ka ru// phyag bya yul min skye bo phyir bsal te// phyag byed snga rting rim bzhin bar yangs snyoms// phal pa rnams la rgyab kyi phyi rgya bskyed// 'gying la gsum yod pus mo 'dzugs ka ru// yar la 'dur na gom gang mar la bsnur// mar la 'dur na gom gang yar la bsnur// yar 'dur mar 'dur gom pa'i srol ma shor// bca' gzhi ri mo gsum pa bzhi dang lnga// kun la dang po mdun gyi ri mor bsdad// gsum pa yin na g.yas pa g.yas su nur// de nas g.yon pa rgyab tu nur byas la// rkang pa'i 'gros bzhin lag pa'i 'khyug kha bya// g.yas pa mdun 'ongs pus btsugs lag stabs 'dzom// bzhi pa dang po mdun du gnas pa 'dra// de nas g.yon pa sngon la g.yon du bzhag /de rjes g.yas pa rgyab tu bzhag byas la// g.yon pas g.yas kyi ri mo mnan byas la// g.yas pa mdun du mdzub rtse g.yon pa brgyab// des dang pus btsugs lag stabs snga ma bzhin// lnga pa'i g.yas pa sngon la dbus su bzhag /de nas ri mo bzhi pa'i rkang stabs bzhin// rkang pa'i 'gros bzhin lag pa'i 'khyug kha ni// de dag kun la mthun par bya dgos te// lag pa dgug dang dbyar ba spang bya ba// legs par dmigs dris bya ba shin tu gces// g.yon gyi pus mo long mo'i rtsar btsugs te// shed pa bsrang zhing yan lag gnas su dbab// gdong pa brang dang ngar gdong drang po ru// nyam nga med par phyag bya'i yul la bstan// rkang 'gros lag pa'i 'khyug ga mdzes pa ni// nar ma khyad par kun la dgos pas gces// 'dzum ni gsum ste phyag dang bca' gzhis 'khyug

/dang po thal mo sbyar nas brkyang la 'bul// gnyis pa lus po mi bsgrims lhod chags pas// lag gnyis pus steng bsrangs te seng ge'i 'gying*// 'khyug pa'i 'dzum ni 'gugs pa'i mtshams su ste// gang 'gugs rkang pa'i phyogs gcig dor la bya// 'dur gyi dpe la rnam pa gsum yod de// che 'dur seng ge ma phyir bsnyegs pa 'dra// chung 'dur 'dab chags snyi la zin pa 'dra// drang 'dur shel sgong rbab la 'dril ba 'dra// gom stabs che chung sa yul stabs dang sbyar// 'dur gyi yan lag lag pa'i 'khyug kha ni// rkang g.yas 'dor na lag g.yon mdun du 'khyug /rkang g.yon 'dor na lag g.yas mdun du 'khyug /lag pa mi khug ma 'byar bde bde 'dra// spyan gzigs sngon 'gro 'dur nas 'khyug pa la// bcam tse yod kyang mi sto skabs kyis brtag /bsnyun med dus su skad gdangs ran pa dang*// zhum med tshig gis ma nor gsal bar brjod// ji skad snyun gsol yul gyi bye brag las// ring thung ci rigs yun gyi stabs dang sbyar// bcas lugs bzhi ste mchims kyi brjid tshul dang*// khri bzang yab lhag 'gos kyi rgan lugs dang*// rgyal tsha lha snang sna nam dpal lugs dang*// rgyal tong mi shu pu'i mdzes lugs so// skyon spang gsum yin pus mo 'dzugs pa'i tshe// rkang pa rgyab tu ring du mi mnar zhing*// lus kyi khyon yang ya yo med pa ste// lag pa'i skyog kha rgyab tu thal mi bya// dgra ya bzhi yod sa yul dogs pa dang*// lus sems bral dang rang bzhin btab pa dang*// khog tu sla chos byed pa'i phyag dgra spangs// 'bras bu dkon mchog bla ma dge bshes la// dad pas phyag byas sgo gsum sgrib pa 'dag /kun gyi ya rabs spyod tshul bstan pa yin// de dag don skor nyi shu rtsa gcig go /phyag la sgrig dus sna 'dren phyir 'brangs dang*// mjug sdud ldang lugs rnams kyi dpe lo ni// 'dab chags bya ma lug gis 'phur 'jol bzhin// gong mas pus btsugs 'og mas rim gyis gzugs// ldang ba'i lugs kyang de bzhin rim pas ldang*// kun tu spyod lam bca' gzhi 'phrug par bya// zin nas gos khyer tshul gyis spyod lam ni// 'gab rdul mi che phyogs logs mi bskor 'tshal// ma rabs g.yung po rnams la 'di mi dgos// ya rabs gra ma rnams kyi srol brgyan 'di// brtson 'grus g.yung drung khu yi ban+de yis// 'gos kyi phyag yig che la brten nas mdzad// de la cung zad ma tshang gong 'og 'khrul// bag tsam nor bar gyur pa'i skyon spangs te// 'khon gyi ban+de grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis// ya rabs cha rkyen 'di ni gsal bar byas// dge des 'gro kun rigs mtho thob gyur nas// tshogs gnyis rdzogs te sangs rgyas sar 'gro shog

/don skor nyi shu rtsa gcig yan lag dang bcas pa'i phyag yig dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so// //rgyal khrims med pa'i btsad po yis// lugs dang mthun pa mi shes pas// 'di la snyun gsol ga la dgos// de bas 'bri bar yong mi byed// cung zad mnga' thang yod gyur kyang*// chung gsum man chad phyag gi lugs// ci dran tsam zhig bya ba las// de bas lhag pas ci zhig bya// 'di ni legs par smras pa yin no// nyi shu rtsa gcig sum phrugs khug pa/ rta rgab 'khyug pa/ mthung ngu gcig tshugs/ rtse sprod rgod po gshog dang lnga/ maṅga laṃ bha wan tu// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
